findings.title: Installed packaged app has no owner-facing Codex adapter install or pairing journey
steps: Build and install the packaged Kennel app from 6c11583.
Launch /Applications/Kennel.app and wait for the daemon-backed Project surface.
Inspect every Settings section: General, AI providers & API keys, Updates, Help.
findings.expected: A real owner can install the Codex adapter and open the pairing intent through a discoverable product path, then proceed to challenge/prove/bearer authentication.
findings.actual: Settings exposes no adapter, harness, connection, pairing, rotation, or revoke control. AI providers & API keys offers provider fields and a local credential setting only.
findings.userImpact: The Stage 3 live journey cannot advance beyond installation. Pairing, negative proof, rotation, revocation, restart durability, and upgrade survival have no owner-flow entry point and therefore are unproven.
findings.reproducibility: Observed once on the installed arm64 package; deterministic visible surface.
findings.recommendation: Do not claim Stage 3 exit. Provide a discoverable, daemon-backed owner path for trusted Codex adapter installation and pairing, with truthful state and evidence; then rerun this journey from a fresh isolated profile.
findings.suggestedRegression: Packaged-app Computer Use test: Settings or connection surface exposes Codex install, opens pairing intent, completes valid challenge/prove/bearer flow, and reports rejected wrong/replayed proofs without exposing secrets.
